18/S0.subgoal: Identify the primary categories of tracking technologies used in VR and AR.

18/S1.subgoal: Describe the types and applications of electromechanical trackers.

18/S2.subgoal: Explain how electromagnetic trackers use magnetic fields to determine position.

18/S3.subgoal: Describe acoustic tracking and the main categories of vision-based tracking.

18/S4.subgoal: Describe how infrared tracking uses targets and cameras in outside-in and inside-out configurations.

18/S5.subgoal: Explain fiducial tracking and the different types of fiducials used.

18/S6.subgoal: Describe natural feature tracking and the algorithms used for pose estimation.

18/S7.subgoal: Explain model-based tracking, including SLAM and PTAM techniques.

18/S8.subgoal: Describe 3D structure tracking and its use in creating 3D environment models.

18/S9.subgoal: Describe inertial and GPS tracking systems.

18/S10.subgoal: Explain motion capture, eye-tracking, and hybrid tracking systems.

18/S11.subgoal: Summarize the main points of the lecture.
